policy.scope: P47 41-5902 recorded-power climb configuration only; retain clean v2.8 and all previous source-climb coefficients
policy.baseline: v3.3 fixed transferred deltaCd0 from 41-5931; also refit a constant-Cd control on identical fit rows
policy.selection: Lowest mean squared fit residual only; break exact ties by fewer heat assumptions (lower heatFraction). Do not use check residuals to select candidates. New fit/check declarations occur after the v3.3 results were exposed; this is not blind validation.

stress.policy: Paired fixed-coefficient scenarios; both model and controls use identical mass and retained-power assumptions, fixed clean polar and recorded shaft BHP. Not historical uncertainty intervals.

policy.mechanism: Blend constant additional drag coefficient with a shaft-power-proportional loss. The latter is represented by deltaCd scaling as P/(rho*V^3), so added drag POWER is proportional to recorded shaft power. This is an aggregate configuration-loss hypothesis, not identified cooling physics or an installed heat-flow measurement.
policy.exclusions: No new aircraft, Atlas changes, generic engine-curve extension, coefficient transfer to Spitfire, or historical turn/stall accuracy claims. Keep Spitfire 32000-ft boost unresolved.
